subject: Marine Works - Dredging - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Dredging - Vancouver Harbour
Dredging Operations will take place in Second Narrows in the vicinity of 49 17.688N 123 01.185W.
Hours of operation generally from 1400UTC to 0000UTC Monday to Saturday.  Operations may be extended to 24 hours per day.
FRPD on site monitoring VHF Channel 69, 74. 
Minimum wake. 
                                                    Cancels NW-P-1472-26
